title: The role of humans in translation facing AI dominance
seoTitle: Translation: AI dominates, but humans still needed
subtitle: Artificial intelligence dominates the translation market, yet high‑risk work still requires human involvement.
excerpt: Artificial intelligence dominates the translation market, but human effort remains essential for high‑risk services, according to analysis.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Technological advancement has profoundly transformed various sectors of the global economy. Today, artificial intelligence dominates the translation market, playing a prominent role in the daily demands of this professional field.

Despite this widespread technological predominance, human involvement remains indispensable. For high‑risk tasks, the presence of specialized people is still a fundamental requirement in the sector.

The coexistence of automated tools and human supervision defines the current landscape of the field. While technology handles the bulk of the business volume, the most critical demands continue to rely exclusively on human capability.

With information from BBC News.
